title: Every Banana Is a Little Radioactive
pause_note: Short format v3: 20-30 s, claim first, loop ending

beats: Every banana is a little radioactive.
Bananas are rich in potassium, and about one potassium atom in ten thousand is radioactive.
Your body is full of the same atoms, hundreds of times more than a banana.
Eating one doesn't make you more radioactive: your body flushes out the extra potassium.
You're more radioactive than the banana.
